sonnet.problem: The answer to this fill-in-the-blank, Galilee, was already given on earlier story cards. Stop 1 card 12 says Mary Magdalene had followed Jesus 'in Galilee', and stop 2 card 1 says the same of Salome. The other answers, Bethany and Emmaus, appear nowhere, so a baker can pick Galilee just by remembering the word.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.
